name: Isurugi Sae
source:
Sae, from the same grade as Kaoruko, is the president of the science club. She makes coffee with vacuum coffee maker she made from laboratory equipment (a laboratory flask, for example) for the lab's visitors. She talks with poor feelings.

[Taken from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Otome_wa_Boku_ni_Koishiteru_characters#Otome_wa_Boku_ni_Koishiteru:_Futari_no_Elder]Wikipedia[/url].]
